'''Ambar's Big Game, Tackle, and Gear Shop''' was a store founded by [[Drexler Ambar]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. It was the only place on the moon to rent winter gear, either for recreation or survival. The store catered to those looking to rent an [[ice sailing craft]], a [[turbo-sled]], [[Ski/Legends|skis]], or [[snow boots]]. Guide and tracking services, maps for fishing holes, notices of [[d'oemir bear]] sightings, and information on [[mariqar snow q'lk]] migrations were also available. The store was run by the [[Ambar family]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="BSS" />
